rationale: HelloController.greeting is a @Get() route handler in a @Controller('hello') class; the in-repo e2e test request-scope.spec.ts boots HelloModule via createNestApplication and issues GET /hello, which NestJS's in-repo router dispatches to the method via reflect-metadata. framework-lifecycle-dispatch describes exactly this @Get-decorated NestJS handler dispatch, yet the entry was not caught. All textual greeting( calls resolve to service methods, not this handler.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The prior regression verdict with framework-lifecycle-dispatch is correct.
